body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a supreme royal knight-king. BOTH ARMS MUST BE RAISED AND LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES AT SHOULDER HEIGHT LIKE A SCARECROW (this is mandatory -- NOT down at the sides, NOT hanging near the hips, elbows perfectly straight, each arm forming one continuous straight horizontal line from shoulder to fingertip), both blocky hands open with fingers spread, a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso, nothing held, fully visible in frame. UNMISTAKABLY CROWNED: a tall blocky gold crown block with at least 5 sharp spike-blocks worn directly on top of the head. A black domino half-mask block. Large black blocky wing-shapes mounted flat against the back. A gold scepter block strapped diagonally across the back. A short black-and-gold cape block ending above the knee. Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, flat blocks with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge, flat hard-contrast shading. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin, no text, no logos, no watermark
